$comment: AI plan workflow configuration. Paths are relative to the workspace root (the folder containing CLAUDE.md).
$comment_archivePrefix: Tokens: YYYY MM DD HH mm ss (local time). Prepended to the plan file name on archival.

archive.$comment: allowUnlistedByDefault: true lets complete and archival proceed when a worktree has uncommitted changes that no active plan lists in Files Affected (they are left uncommitted and recorded). Changes listed by another active plan never block. false (default) stops until --allow-unlisted is passed.

repositories.$comment: autoDiscover: every immediate sub-folder of the root containing .git (a git worktree or clone) is a worktree, named after the folder and used in ### <worktree> headings. includeRoot: the root itself, if it is a git repo, is named rootName. map: explicit extra/override entries { name: relative/path }.

commit.$comment: Every commit message in a plan is validated against these rules. templateFile is shown to the AI when writing messages.
